title: Zesty Peruvian Skewered Beef Anticuchos
description: A romantic Peruvian dish featuring tender beef, rose water, and a hint of umami. Serve with a side of grilled vegetables for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: beef strips (1 lb)
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced beef strips, preferably ribeye or sirloin

ingredients.name: shredded cheese (Monterey Jack or Queso Fresco)
ingredients.notes: for serving, to melt into a cheesy pull

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400°F (200°C).
Thread beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the spice mixture onto both sides of the beef strips, then brush with rose water.
Thread onion chunks, bell pepper chunks, and mushrooms onto skewers, if desired.
Place skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until beef is cooked to desired doneness.
While skewers are cooking, melt shredded cheese in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Once skewers are cooked, serve hot with the melted cheese sauce ladled over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
For a vegan option, replace beef with portobello mushrooms or eggplant slices.
For a gluten-free option, be sure to use gluten-free soy sauce or tamari, if using.
For a dairy-free option, substitute shredded cheese with a dairy-free alternative, such as vegan mozzarella.
